_readme: Labelled prompt pairs for tuning the cache similarity threshold (SPEC 8.5). EQUIVALENT pairs SHOULD share a cached answer -- missing them costs hit rate. DANGEROUS pairs MUST NOT share one -- serving a cached answer across them returns a WRONG answer to a real user. The threshold is the line between these two sets, and there is no value that separates them perfectly.
_why_dangerous_pairs_matter: Every dangerous pair below is superficially similar -- often one word apart -- but has a materially different correct answer. These are not adversarial edge cases invented to make a point; they are the ordinary shape of real traffic. A cache tuned only for hit rate will serve the wrong one.
